subject: EdgeGrid private cluster: sudden p95 latency + 503 spike
messages:
From: Sophie Adams <sophie@edgegrid.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: kyle.turner@edgegrid.ai
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Production: private cluster p95 jump / 503s observed

Hi Ben,

We started seeing a sustained p95 latency jump on our private VPC cluster (customer: EdgeGrid) around 14:45 PDT and it has persisted. Token generation p95 moved from ~280ms normally to ~1.2s and we saw a burst of 503 responses for short-lived streams. Attached is a quick p95/export from our side (edgegrid_p95_report-20260604.pdf).

What we're seeing:
- Time window: 14:45 - 15:35 PDT
- Endpoint: /v1/generate/batched (batch=dynamic)
- Error mode: transient 503s (~3% of requests over window), elevated decoding time, occasional token drops in streaming.
- Impact: two customer-facing jobs timed out and failed retries.

This is a priority for us — production traffic is affected. Can Redwood confirm whether this is a runtime regression, config change, or something network-related in the private deployment? We're on 1.13.2 of the runtime and using the pinned model rwd-llama-13b-q4f.

Thanks,
Sophie

--
Sophie Adams
SRE Lead, EdgeGrid Systems

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production: private cluster p95 jump / 503s observed

Ben/Team,

Quick update from the SRE triage: I pulled the runtime logs and correlated with the kv cache snapshots Sophie provided. High-level findings:

- GPU utilization on the host is steady and not fully saturated (peak 64%).
- We see many short-lived lock contention events in the runtime (KV cache metadata path) starting at 14:42 PDT; those line up with their p95 jump.
- A recent background compaction job in their on-prem orchestration (not Redwood-managed) appears to have increased I/O wait spikes; this correlates with a slight increase in avg decode times.
- There are intermittent 503s emitted by the local proxy when internal request queues spike beyond configured burst limit (proxy config: burst_limit=1024).

Immediate mitigation I recommend:
1) Increase proxy burst_limit to 2500 as a temporary safety net.
2) Apply a conservative KV cache soft-lock timeout bump (from 50ms -> 150ms) to avoid thrashing during compaction events.
3) Revert a non-critical runtime kernel flag (fast_kv_prefetch=true) that looks to cause contention under their sequence profile.

I attached the kv cache snapshot we got back (kv_cache_snapshot-20260604.txt) and a short diagnostic grep. I'm happy to push a canary config change if Ops can approve a rolling restart window.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Adams <sophie@edgegrid.ai>, EdgeGrid Ops <ops@edgegrid.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production: private cluster p95 jump / 503s observed

Sophie / Kyle,

Thanks for the quick signal and for attaching the export. Marcus dug in and identified a likely interaction between your recent compaction workload and our KV cache paths plus a proxy queue saturation edge-case.

Proposed immediate plan (short window ops):
- Tonight 23:00 PDT: apply proxy burst_limit increase to 2500 (no restart).
- 23:15 PDT: apply KV soft-lock timeout bump and flip fast_kv_prefetch=false behind a canary that targets 10% of request traffic; monitor p95 and 503s for 20 minutes.
- If stable, roll the config to 100% by 00:15 PDT.

We will keep you updated every 15 minutes during the window. If you'd prefer a different maintenance window speak up now.

Also, Laura/Vivek: we should prepare an exec summary for EdgeGrid leadership outlining root cause (compaction + KV contention), mitigations, and an offer for a one-week elevated support/credits in case of customer impact.

Ben
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production: private cluster p95 jump / 503s observed

Thanks team — good triage. We'll proceed with the planned window and I drafted a one-page exec note for EdgeGrid leadership (attached: proposed-tuning-plan-20260605.docx). Key bullets:

- Impact summary: transient p95 up to 1.2s and ~3% 503s during compaction window; no data leakage and no model regressions.
- Root cause (prelim): external batch compaction increased host I/O wait which exacerbated KV cache lock contention in the runtime; under burst the local proxy emitted 503s.
- Short-term remediation: config changes outlined by Marcus (proxy burst limit + KV soft-lock bump + revert prefetch flag) with canary rollout; committed monitoring and 15-minute updates.
- Customer goodwill: offer one-week usage credit up to $12k and priority on Dedicated scheduling if they want reserved capacity.

Vivek will lead the customer sync at 12:30 PDT after the canary completes; I'll push the exec note to Sophie/Kyle right after.

Laura
